data.name: Daleel
data.gender_notes: Daleel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Daleel is derived from the root 'd-l-l', meaning 'to guide' or 'to lead'. This name is mentioned in the Quran to describe Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) as a guide for mankind. Daleel is a spiritual name with deep roots in Islamic history. The name Daleel carries the meaning “Guide, helper, assistant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daleel usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper, assistant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
